nodes.label: Home Hero Background
nodes.description: Cinematic golden-toned hero image showing UAE national symbols: a stylized golden map of the UAE inside a circular frame, surrounded by Dubai skyline (Burj Khalifa), a mosque, the UAE flag, a high-speed train, solar panels, a satellite dish, a satellite, a drone, a fighter jet, and a naval warship. Represents UAE national power, technology, defense, and modernization for the dashboard's landing/home page.

nodes.label: UAE Country Map
nodes.description: Golden silhouette of the United Arab Emirates geographic outline, central focal point of the hero composition.

nodes.label: Placeholder Logo (L)
nodes.description: Simple SVG logo: a white circle with blue (#4F8EF7) stroke containing the letter 'L'. Placeholder branding asset for the application.

nodes.label: Manager Portrait
nodes.description: Professional studio portrait of an older man with white hair and beard wearing a dark navy suit, arms crossed, against a dark backdrop. Represents the manager/executive figure in the dashboard.

nodes.label: President Portrait
nodes.description: Official portrait of a man in traditional Emirati attire (white kandura, bisht, and ghutra with black agal) against a deep red background with the UAE flag at left. Depicts the UAE President (Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan) for the dashboard.

nodes.label: UAE President
nodes.description: The President of the United Arab Emirates, depicted in the official portrait asset used in the dashboard.
